title: Practice: The -ся passive and present passive participles: читается, издаваемый

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: This house has a heated swimming pool.
exercises.why: Formation: a) it is formed by adding adjectival endings to the 1st person plural of the present tense of a transitive imperfective verb: мы описываем — описываемый; мы производим — производимый. b) In the давать group the suffix -ва- is retained: издавать — издаваемый. c) When no present passive participle can be formed, one may be borrowed from a verb close in meaning: ждать — ожидаемый; хотеть — желаемый. d) Some are widely used as adjectives: любимый, уважаемый, непереводимый. — DLI, Lessons 96 and 97.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Formation: a) it is formed by adding adjectival endings to the 1st person plural of the present tense of a transitive imperfective verb: мы описываем — описываемый; мы производим — производимый.…
